Method Detail

load

public void load(model.DEditor editor,
                 javax.swing.JDesktopPane jdp,
                 model.DEditSchema schema,
                 javax.swing.JMenuBar menuBar)
Loads a plugin into the DEditor and its important final components.

Parameters:
editor - the DEditor that will receive this plugin
jdp - the JDesktopPane all JInternalFrame's / DEditXMLWindow's will appear in
schema - the DEditSchema for editor
menuBar - the JMenuBar used by editor

edit

public boolean edit(model.DEditNode selected)
Plugin potential override / add-on for editing nodes. Returns true iff no more editing should occur after this function. If it returns false the standard editing dialog will be displayed

Parameters:
selected - the DEditNode that might be edited
Returns:
true if editing should stop after this function

isEditable

public boolean isEditable(model.DEditNode selected,
                          boolean defaultEnabled)
Returns whether or not the input node should be editable.

Parameters:
selected - the DEditNode in question for editable / not editable
defaultEnabled - true if Schema says it should be editable (i.e., has parameters or is a leaf element)
Returns:
true if selected DEditNode should be editable

isCuttable

public boolean isCuttable(model.DEditNode selected)
Puts restrictions on what is cuttable above and beyond Schema restrictions. Returns true when it should be cuttable if the Schema allows it.

Parameters:
selected - the node in question for cuttable / uncuttable
Returns:
true if it should be cuttable if allowed by schema

isCopyable

public boolean isCopyable(model.DEditNode selected)
Puts restrictions on what is copyable above and beyond Schema restrictions. Returns true when it should be copyable if the Schema allows it.

Parameters:
selected - the node in question for copyable / uncopyable
Returns:
true if it should be copyable if allowed by schema

newTagBeforeAllowed

public boolean newTagBeforeAllowed(model.DEditNode selected)
Puts restrictions on where new tags may be be inserted above and beyond Schema restrictions. The input DEditNode is the node that the new node will be inserted before.

Parameters:
selected - the node queried to see if insert before it is ever allowed
Returns:
true if given that it is valid under the Schema, a node may be inserted before this node

newChildTagAllowed

public boolean newChildTagAllowed(model.DEditNode selected)
Puts restrictions on where new tags may be be inserted above and beyond Schema restrictions. The input DEditNode is the node that the new node will be inserted as a child of.

Parameters:
selected - the node queried to see if insert as its child is ever allowed
Returns:
true if given that it is valid under the Schema, a node may be inserted as a child of this node

newTagAfterAllowed

public boolean newTagAfterAllowed(model.DEditNode selected)
Puts restrictions on where new tags may be be inserted above and beyond Schema restrictions. The input DEditNode is the node that the new node will be inserted after.

Parameters:
selected - the node queried to see if insert after it is ever allowed
Returns:
true if given that it is valid under the Schema, a node may be inserted after this node

switchTagToAllowed

public boolean switchTagToAllowed(model.DEditNode selected)
Puts restrictions on what tags may be switched to other types of tags valid in the same place above.

Parameters:
selected - the node in question for switchable / unswitchable
Returns:
true if node is ever switchable

pasteChildAllowed

public boolean pasteChildAllowed(model.DEditNode selected)
Puts restrictions on whether or not a particular node should allow something to be pasted in as a child of the DEditNode passed in if the Schema allows it

Parameters:
selected - the node for which to decide if pasting a node as a child should be allowed if the Schema allows it
Returns:
true if node can ever accept children to be pasted

Returns:

getTreeHelpID

public java.lang.String getTreeHelpID()
Gets the String ID for JavaHelp that it should use to display help for the main tree. All DEditXMLWindows query the plugin for this. If you want to use default behavior, return null.

Returns:
the String ID for JavaHelp to use to display help for the JTree

getTreeCellRendererComponent

public java.awt.Component getTreeCellRendererComponent(model.DEditTreeCellRenderer rndr,
                                                       javax.swing.JTree tree,
                                                       model.DEditNode node,
                                                       boolean selected,
                                                       boolean expanded,
                                                       boolean leaf,
                                                       int row,
                                                       boolean hasFocus)
Essentially the same as the TreeCellRenderer function, except that Object value is replaced with DEditNode node (it's the same object) to save casting on the plugin side. It also receives the renderer from the DEditTreeCellRenderer's rendering, which you can return to have default behavior.

Parameters:
rndr - the result of DEditTreeCellRenderer.getTreeCellRendererComponenent()
tree - same as TreeCellRenderer.getTreeCellRendererComponent()
node - the Object called "value" from TreeCellRenderer.getTreeCellRendererComponent()
selected - same as TreeCellRenderer.getTreeCellRendererComponent()
expanded - same as TreeCellRenderer.getTreeCellRendererComponent()
leaf - same as TreeCellRenderer.getTreeCellRendererComponent()
row - same as TreeCellRenderer.getTreeCellRendererComponent()
hasFocus - same as TreeCellRenderer.getTreeCellRendererComponent()
Returns:
a Component with which to display DEditNode node
